A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<table><tr><td><img src="a.svg" alt="A"> <a href="/1">x</a></td><td><a href="/2">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href="/3">z</a></td></tr></table>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
